change: Resume two-access pipeline refill across bounded DMA units, preserve Game Pak sequencing, branch retirement, SWI/IRQ banked state and IRQ entry without instruction retirement
hardware: Linux x86_64 cloud host; Temurin 21.0.8+9; Maven 3.9.11; no physical GBA/Bold

same_mode_bx.normalization: NBA original two-cycle normal request aged by one for readiness 1; Java injects raw HBlank readiness 1/2; ready=0 means no DMA

instruction_exception_forms.normalization: Both adapters use raw readiness. NBA schedules its original registered DMA activation handler for enabled HBlank DMA3. ready=0 means no DMA, not immediate readiness.
instruction_exception_forms.irq_boundary: NBA public Run enters accepted IRQ and executes the first synthetic BIOS handler NOP. Java stops at the same first handler retirement. Peripheral IRQ-line latency/priority is not qualified.

independent_comparison.scope: Selected readiness-normalized bus/retirement and first-handler observations; no general hardware, full pipeline or activation/lifecycle qualification

regressions.before_bridge: Constant-false public BusTiming.refilling() query added only to isolated old classes so new tests can load; no emulation changes
coverage: 36 same-mode BX observations including Game Pak N/S interruption
State-changing BX uses target width for ROM refill
SWI link/status are banked once before waiting
SPSR-restored Thumb width and original-bank LDM writeback survive refill DMA
IRQ entry and branch defer handler execution until refill completes
Internal DMA completion begins refill but yields before another DMA unit
Release request grants one waiting refill access before next arbitration
Readiness at final refill end belongs to next bus access
Three 65536-word branch/IRQ transfers yield at frame/audio budgets without replay
